capabilities.name: MO-021 Deterministic Pipeline Evaluation Baseline
capabilities.responsibility: Execute registered Intelligence evaluation scenarios through an injected stage-adapter pipeline, score transparent assertions, and aggregate deterministic baseline reports across repeated runs.
capabilities.authority_role: Historical deterministic evaluation infrastructure only. Its hard-coded stage order predates the current guarded canonical orchestration and therefore cannot establish current end-to-end fitness without repair.
safety_invariants: The runner executes only explicitly supplied stage adapters and contains no insurance reasoning or assertion logic.
The assertion engine scores captured runs without modifying or re-executing the pipeline.

This capability must not be represented as current final-evaluation coverage while its stage order omits authority, reconciliation, instance-sufficiency, guarded evidence/decision/explanation, rendering and final-evaluation stages.
capabilities.notes: Code remains useful and tested, but PIPELINE_STAGE_ORDER ends at the legacy RESPONSE_ASSEMBLER path and is not the current canonical guarded response order.
